_comment: Declarative AutoForm layout for the ① Compute LUT panel. The interactive raw/after TAC plots (draggable linear region + offset/threshold lines) are the custom 'lut_compute_plot' section driving the Qt-free LutComputeViewModel; parameters are declarative value/toggle sections with tooltips.

options.title: ① Compute LUT — help
options.text:
This is the main tool. Build TAC-linearization LUTs from a **uniform-illumination** (uncorrelated-light / scatter) measurement — light that *should* give a flat TAC histogram. Real TAC hardware (e.g. SPC-130) has differential non-linearity **per routing channel**, so one LUT is computed per channel.

**Steps:** load the file(s) → **➡ Add all channels to setup**. A LUT is computed for every routing channel (region auto-detected each) and assigned. Use the **Preview channel** selector + the orange region only if you want to check or hand-tune a specific channel first.

Saving a LUT file or a settings.tttr.json (tab ②) is optional — only for sharing a correction between machines.

sections.label: Preview channel
sections.description: Preview / tune THIS routing channel's histogram + region. ‘Add to Detector setup’ computes and assigns a LUT for ALL channels.

sections.label: linear_start
sections.description: First bin of the flat linear region (or drag the orange region).

sections.label: linear_stop
sections.description: First bin after the flat linear region.

sections.label: ntac_required
sections.description: Target number of corrected NTAC bins (defaults to the input bin count).

sections.label: Noffset
sections.description: Offset subtracted from corrected NTAC indices (or drag the red line).

sections.label: preview photons
sections.description: How many photons to use for the corrected-preview histogram.

sections.label: Normalize by region mean
sections.description: Divide the displayed histogram by the region mean (display only).

sections.label: RNG seed
sections.description: Seed for the stochastic rebinning (reproducible previews).

sections.label: Low-count threshold
sections.description: Bins at or below this count are zeroed before building the LUT (or drag the green line).

sections.label: Mitigate wrap spike (floor + ε)
sections.description: Use floor rounding + a small ε to avoid a spike at the wrap boundary.

sections.label: ε (wrap)
sections.description: Epsilon used when 'Mitigate wrap spike' is on.
